items.title: AI Augmentation Techniques with Liberty
items.summary: Building production-grade AI requires more than a model—it requires an ecosystem. IBM technologies such as Liberty provide this ecosystem for the modern enterprise. Paired with Jakarta EE, it creates a formidable platform for AI augmentation. In this session, we will demonstrate how to orchestrate enterprise-ready AI agents using Jakarta EE technologies in combination with AI augmentation approaches such as tools, skills, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We'll showcase seamless integration with IBM Bob to create AI-augmented development workflows that accelerate productivity while maintaining enterprise-grade quality. Of course, all demos run on Liberty from IBM.
